name: image-edit
description: Edit an existing image through a configured provider. PNG files are saved in the current project; use ShareImage to show one in chat.

configSchema.label: Provider
configSchema.hint: Choose an image editing provider: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint reuses its key and base URL, or use the connected ChatGPT account. Add providers in Settings → Brain.

configSchema.label: Model
configSchema.hint: Image model of the chosen provider. The picker offers the models enabled for that provider in Settings → Models; enable one there first. Empty uses the provider's default.
